  - So I run no `destroy:` command and no `git worktree remove`.

## Step 2 - Branch

- The PR is landed, but `git -C /work/mono worktree list --porcelain` still lists `branch refs/heads/feature/backoff` for `/home/dev/scratch/backoff`.

- `git -C /work/mono merge-base --is-ancestor 5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d5d HEAD` succeeds.

The merge-base overrides file has no `## cleanup` section, so no override items run.
